spec_match.rationale: The data-grid use case: a header sticky against the sheet's vertical scroll while a clipped (non-scrolling) horizontal strip keeps it with its columns — the composition the feature exists for.

interactive.rationale: Scroll/measure/reset buttons work; sheet scrollTop and header offset read back live (the final reset leaves the page at its initial readouts, which is why a naive before/after text diff shows no change).

blurb_alignment.rationale: One-ancestor-both-axes problem and the per-axis answer are both shown.

edge_cases.rationale: Contrasts the strip-with-scroll-container (sticky breaks) against the clipped strip, with computed pairs printed.

conformance.rationale: Suite correct; scroll-clip assertions fail on this build (feature absent) — the strip computes scroll/hidden and the page prints exactly that.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Measured live: strip computed scroll/hidden, header answered to the sheet's scroll in the supported arrangement; console clean.

accessibility.rationale: Buttons named, readouts textual, visible focus.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px overflow at 360px — notable for a wide data-grid demo; the sheet scrolls internally.

summary: Verified on headless Chromium 153 (Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12) driven over CDP via a Playwright script — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment; desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 screenshots captured and inspected. Honest on a coercing build; re-verify tracked on the accidental-scrollport critique.
